description: 11e RAPID INGRESS (15.07) 'Arrive' through the real UI, through to the completed ingress move (20.04). Fixture ri_pretrigger: P2 active in battle round 2; P1's Caladius Grav-tank is in strategic reserves. P2 ends the Movement phase with the phase button; the Rapid Ingress dialog opens for PLAYER 1 (the non-active player) and its effect text carries the 20.04 'Before the Third Battle Round' clause (no models in the opponent's deployment zone). A real click on 'Arrive (1 CP)' for the Caladius spends P1's CP and starts the ingress set-up (reinforcement placement) while the Movement phase holds. A real board click sets the Caladius up wholly within 6" of P1's own (top) edge, more than 8" from every enemy unit; a real click on Reset Unit restarts the set-up as a RAPID INGRESS set-up (it used to restart it as an ordinary reinforcement, wiring a second confirm handler), the Caladius is set up again, and a real click on the unit card's Confirm sends PLACE_RAPID_INGRESS_REINFORCEMENT: the tank is DEPLOYED where it was clicked, a toast says it arrived, and the Movement phase then ends (the movement_phase_end window has no FIRE OVERWATCH row for P1 — the Caladius was already targeted by a stratagem this phase (15.01) and nothing else of P1's is within 24" of an enemy). Before this fix the Arrive click was refused ('No unit specified for Rapid Ingress').
